timed_sequence.action: Read the paragraph and confirm it is plain text and one paragraph.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Point to the paragraph and format.

timed_sequence.action: Check for a clear choice and one accurate supplied fact about Park A or Park B.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify the choice and quote the supplied fact.

timed_sequence.action: Check that one sentence connects the fact to the choice; record an observation and a suggestion only within the rubric.
Author answers one clarification question about the evidence.
If disagreement occurs, quote the rubric criterion and record both readings for author or instructor resolution; otherwise recheck evidence.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Identify the disputed wording or confirm no dispute.

timed_sequence.action: Author selects one rubric-aligned revision, or records that no revision is needed, then complete the check.
timed_sequence.artifact_evidence: Record the selected change or no-change decision.

artifact_checks.check: Confirm the paragraph clearly chooses Park A or Park B.
Confirm one fact matches the prompt: Park A has two benches, or Park B has one bench and one fountain.
Confirm one sentence explains how the fact supports the choice.

author_questions: Which words show your choice, and which supplied fact supports it?
revision_choice: Select one change that improves rubric alignment, or record that all three checks are met.
disagreement_procedure: Quote the disputed rubric criterion, state the competing readings, and ask the author or instructor to decide; do not assess personal qualities.
completion_check: Confirm format, choice, fact, connection, evidence locations, and any selected revision are recorded.
